title.narrative: Investment Support to Ukraine Ternopil Bypass

description.narrative: The Project is a greenfield project, as there is no bypass north of the city of Ternopil, forcing traffic currently through the city centre. The first phase of the Project comprises the construction of 8,6 km of new Category I-b (4 traffic lanes) road starting from ¿-19 Road DomanoveLutskTernopilChernivtsiTerebleche (km 315+629) and ending at ¿-12 Road StryiTernopilKropyvnytskyiZnamyanka (km 160+100).
